target_resolution_basis: maximum of measured local ground pixel spacing and documented effective resolution; optional requested resolution may coarsen further
resampling: area-weighted average; no upsampling below source sampling support

information_loss.planetary: No finer spatial detail is created. Source cells are averaged onto the comparison grid; sub-grid terrain and documented interpolated source cells remain unresolved.
information_loss.earth: Fine-scale terrain is aggregated to the coarsest comparison support and is not retained as resolvable detail in the output.

alignment_description: Each body is centered independently on its supplied coordinate and projected to a local azimuthal-equidistant metric grid; matching array indices share physical cell dimensions but not geographic coordinates.
vertical_comparison: relative terrain only; absolute elevations not compared
warnings: Earth and planetary grids use independent local CRSs and origins; array indices represent paired support only.
Vertical datums and reference surfaces are not reconciled; each output is centered on its own valid-cell median.
At least one product has no documented effective spatial resolution; nominal sampling is only a conservative grid floor.
Input vertical references differ and absolute elevations must not be compared.
MGS MOLA MEGDR median topography contains product-documented interpolated cells; they are not direct measurements.
